findings.finding_and_proposed_repair: Journal inspection/append call semantic control validation before raw commit, so structurally valid generation/sequence faults are rejected without raw retention or labelled archive corruption. Separate structural journal checks from replay semantic admission.

findings.finding_and_proposed_repair: Replay callback/trace/definition/policy fields are mutable; quality entry/protection lists remain mutable after hash; journal path mutable. Freeze configuration and captured collections.

findings.finding_and_proposed_repair: Callback counter increments only on successful commit despite failed calls executed. Track attempted versus committed work; disclose full history serialization/rebuild scope instead of suggesting callbacks measure all work.
